verdict.rationale: Square documents a List Payouts API, which supports seeing payouts and when they land, and its marketing promises to help 'manage your cash flow'. The pack has no evidence of next-day or instant transfer options, which is the half of the story about speeding up access to cash. Missing for 10: documented instant or next-day payout capability, payout timing and arrival detail beyond a doc title, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
